company.shortDescription: Verdict is an iPhone app that lets people give and get opinions anonymously.
company.description: Verdict is an iPhone app that lets people give and get opinions anonymously. It works by allowing people to send an image and a description to their friends anonymously (ie ‘What do you think of my watch?’). Other users can then vote the image up or down and the initial user can see the feedback.
